description: This is a PHP source file defining the LicensesSubController class within the Goteo project, specifically for managing license entities in the administrative backend. The class contains methods for handling various actions related to licenses such as listing, adding, editing, moving, removing, and translating licenses, along with permission checks. It interacts with models like License and Icon, and uses utility classes for messaging and logging.

classes.name: LicensesSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing license-related actions within the admin panel of the Goteo project. It includes permission checking and CRUD operations for licenses, along with methods for moving licenses up or down in order and handling translations.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access license management functions based on node master status and user roles.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the translation action for a license, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing license, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new license, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a license up in order, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a license down in order, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Handles license removal, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists licenses, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main handler for license operations including listing, creating, updating, moving, and deleting licenses. Also manages form submissions, validation, and feedback messaging.
